'''Drusa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of the [[Drall/Legends|Drall]] [[Species/Legends|species]] who owned the [[Luminous Gardens]] health spa on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drall (planet)|Drall]], and provided the [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Sarella]] with information about local and [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] politics.
